column1: PantryPulse — DEDUCTION METHOD (applies to all deduction households: h1b,h2,h3,h4,h5,h6,h7)
Every SKU deduction must be a calculation with a stated reason. No guessed round numbers.
FORMULA (per dish, per ingredient)
1) need = portion_per_person  ×  eaters  ×  dish_intensity
2) deduct = min(need, available)                    — NEVER exceed what is in stock
3) if (available - deduct) <= orphan_threshold(role) then deduct = available   — use it all, do not leave a useless scrap
4) if available = 0  ->  deduct = 0  and FLAG (item not present: not used, or a substitute was; do not invent it)
5) if several interchangeable variants are present (e.g. 3 capsicum colours), split need across them PROPORTIONALLY to availability so they deplete evenly

column1: OVER-DEDUCTION GUARD (added 11-Aug, v21_428) — automatic unit-bug catch
Purpose: catch the grams-as-pieces bug (e.g. 40 g carrot subtracted as 40 pieces).
On every close, diff pre vs post board. For any pc-unit produce item touched that day:
ceiling = max(2.0, 1.2 × pax)  pieces removable in one close
IF pieces_removed > ceiling:
• left a fractional remainder (e.g. 2.58 pc) -> HIGH (blocks build, must fix)
• took it all to 0 (finishing stock)         -> REVIEW (glance, allowed)
• else                                        -> REVIEW
HIGH flags must be resolved before the build ships (gate returns non-zero).
Also runs live in-app: Deduction Audit panel on each board flags same-day pc over-draws.
